description: Get a named basis, crack or ratio spread (for example wti_brent, 321, diesel_crack, lng_us_europe) against its trailing distribution: current value and legs, mean, standard deviation, min, max, z-score and percentile (type=current, the default), or its daily series (type=historical). Omit spread to list the available spread names. Use when the user asks whether a spread is wide or narrow relative to recent history; opa_get_spread returns current crack, basis and margin values without the distribution. Analytics are plan-gated: the API answers HTTP 403 when the account's plan does not include them. Requires an eligible account entitlement. Use opa_get_plans for current access and pricing; the API response is authoritative.

spread.description: Spread name, e.g. 'wti_brent'. Omit to list available spreads.

name: opa_get_spread_statistics
title: Get Spread Statistics
